written.headline: Dream raises $17 million to build AI world models for construction
written.summary: Former Palantir executives Andy Elder and Arjun Mathur launched Dream, a startup that trains AI on over 100 million square feet of permitted U.S. building data to generate engineering‑grade designs. The company emerged from stealth with a $17 million seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz and is already serving as architect of record on ten projects in Texas and California.
